summary: Iteration 20 - Payment Suspension Feature Testing Complete. All backend APIs (12/12 tests passed) and frontend UI components working correctly. The payment suspension system allows Super Admin to suspend gyms for non-payment, blocking gym admin and member access until reactivation.
passed_tests: PUT /api/gyms/{id}/payment-suspend toggles payment_suspended status (Super Admin only)
POST /api/auth/admin/login for gym admin of suspended gym returns gym_status='payment_suspended'
POST /api/auth/member/login for member of suspended gym returns 403 'Cuenta Bloqueada'
GET /api/auth/member/me for member of suspended gym returns 403 'Cuenta Bloqueada'
POST /api/access/validate for suspended gym returns valid=false with reason 'Gimnasio suspendido por falta de pago'
AdminGyms page shows 'IMPAGO' badge on suspended gym (data-testid='gym-payment-suspended-badge-{id}')
AdminGyms dropdown menu has 'Suspender por Impago' option (data-testid='gym-payment-suspend-{id}')
AdminGyms dropdown shows 'Reactivar (Pago recibido)' when gym is suspended
Gym Admin login shows fullscreen blocking screen (data-testid='payment-suspended-screen')
Blocking screen shows 'Cuenta Suspendida por falta de pago' message
After reactivation (toggle back), gym admin can access dashboard normally
After reactivation, member can login normally (verified via API)
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: gym_routes.py payment-suspend endpoint correctly toggles between 'active' and 'payment_suspended' status
Backend: auth_routes.py correctly checks gym payment_suspended status and returns gym_status in admin login response
Backend: auth_routes.py member login correctly returns 403 'Cuenta Bloqueada' for suspended gyms
Backend: access_routes.py QR validation correctly blocks access with reason about suspension
Frontend: AdminGyms.js correctly shows IMPAGO badge with data-testid for suspended gyms
Frontend: AdminGyms.js dropdown correctly shows 'Suspender por Impago' or 'Reactivar (Pago recibido)' based on status
Frontend: AdminLayout.js correctly shows fullscreen blocking screen for gym admins of suspended gyms
Frontend: MemberLogin.js correctly shows 'Cuenta Bloqueada' screen when gym is suspended
seed_data_creation: None - used existing FitZone Gym and member NEDFJR
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 20 tested the Payment Suspension feature. FitZone Gym (ID: efe99507-15d5-4e54-9f07-30d2507894e0) is currently ACTIVE after testing. The payment suspension system works correctly: Super Admin can suspend gyms via PUT /api/gyms/{id}/payment-suspend, which blocks gym admin access (shows fullscreen 'Cuenta Suspendida' screen) and member access (shows 'Cuenta Bloqueada' screen). QR access validation also returns valid=false for suspended gyms. The IMPAGO badge appears on gym cards in AdminGyms page when suspended.

qr_access_blocking.response: valid=false, reason='Gimnasio suspendido por falta de pago'
